label: SIMPLE_4: SIMPLE_4 means without composition of any kind, including quantitative parts, matter/form…
definition: Simple means without composition of any kind (ST I q.3 a.7), including quantitative parts, matter/form, nature/suppositum, essence/being, genus/difference and subject/accident. The case encodes this as IsSimple Composite g := ¬ Composite g. Composite is a primitive covering every relevant composition; the predicate is not merely the denial of matter-form composition.
note: The source supplies the meaning and asserts it of God. Which structures the primitive Composite represents remains an interpretation of the signature; this metadata does not add a Lean equivalence or discharge a premise.
